name: amfepramone
summary: Amfepramone, also known as diethylpropion, is a stimulant drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and cathinone classes that is used as an appetite suppressant. It is used in the short-term management of obesity, along with dietary and lifestyle changes.

pharmacology.text: Amfepramone itself lacks any affinity for the monoamine transporters and instead functions as a prodrug to ethcathinone. Ethcathinone (and therefore amfepramone as well) is a very weak dopaminergic and serotonergic, and is approximately 10× and 20× stronger on norepinephrine in comparison, respectively.

uses.text: Amfepramone, also known as diethylpropion, is a stimulant drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and cathinone classes that is used as an appetite suppressant. It is used in the short-term management of obesity, along with dietary and lifestyle changes.
uses.recreational: The authors of several studies of amfepramone claim that the substance has a relatively low potential for causing addiction in users.

summaryZh: 安非拉酮（英語：Amfepramone）是苯乙胺、苯丙胺和卡西酮類的興奮劑藥物，用作食慾抑制劑。它用於肥胖的短期管理，以及飲食和生活方式的改變。安非拉酮與抗抑鬱藥和戒煙助劑安非他酮在化學上的關係最密切，安非他酮與納曲酮組合後也被開發為減肥藥。

sideEffects.en: Reported effects include a dry mouth, sleeplessness, restlessness, a fast heartbeat and raised blood pressure. It can cause dependence, and in Europe its approval was restricted over the risk of pulmonary hypertension and heart valve problems.
sideEffects.zh: 回報的反應包括口乾、失眠、躁動不安、心跳加快與血壓升高。它可能造成成癮，歐洲也因肺動脈高壓與心臟瓣膜問題的風險而限制其許可。
sideEffects.zhHans: 回报的反应包括口干、失眠、躁动不安、心跳加快与血压升高。它可能造成成瘾，欧洲也因肺动脉高压与心脏瓣膜问题的风险而限制其许可。

fact.en: Better known as diethylpropion, it is a cathinone, the same family as the stimulant found in khat leaves. It is a prodrug, so it only works once the body has turned it into ethcathinone.
fact.zh: 它更為人熟知的名稱是 diethylpropion，屬於卡西酮類，與阿拉伯茶葉中的興奮成分同屬一個家族。它是前驅藥，必須在體內轉化為 ethcathinone 才會作用。
fact.zhHans: 它更为人熟知的名称是 diethylpropion，属于卡西酮类，与阿拉伯茶叶中的兴奋成分同属一个家族。它是前驱药，必须在体内转化为 ethcathinone 才会作用。
